acceptance_gate.condition: in_domain_judge_auroc present AND shuffled_label_control_auroc present AND ood_judge_auroc present
acceptance_gate.principle: An OOD-transfer claim requires an in-domain sanity pass AND a shuffled-label adversarial control -- without both the OOD number could be a degenerate-prior artifact.

field_principles.duration_s: Plausibility floor (a real train+eval takes minutes, not seconds).
field_principles.in_domain_judge_auroc: Sanity: the trained judge must work in-domain before any OOD claim is meaningful.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The train/eval substrate and GPU disclosure; this prototype trains only a small CPU head over cached scores.
field_principles.judge_recipe: The trained judge's features/loss/epochs -- reproducibility of the prototype.
field_principles.ood_domains_tested: Which OOD domains (code/facts) were evaluated -- scopes the transfer claim.
field_principles.ood_judge_auroc: The core number: does the trained judge detect errors in a domain it was NOT trained on?
field_principles.shuffled_label_control_auroc: Adversarial control: a near-0.5 here confirms the judge is not learning a degenerate prior.
field_principles.trained_judge_transfers_ood: True iff the trained judge beats both confidence-only and shuffled-control on OOD -- the falsifiable transfer claim.
field_principles.trained_judge_vs_fixed_ensemble_ood_delt: Does TRAINING the judge buy the OOD transfer the fixed ensemble (.329-.333) lacked -- the foundation-model-path signal.

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: trains a small head on cached labels + scores cached corpora; GPU use: none, CPU-only numpy).

judge_recipe.loss: L2-regularized binary cross-entropy on math error_label; score is P(error).
judge_recipe.train_eval_split: 80/20 stratified FoVer math split per seed; OOD labels are never used for training.
